notes: Reactor hidden photon (dark photon) kinetic mixing limit from TEXONO data. The exclusion is presented only in Fig.1 (Log10 eps vs Log10 mX). Numerical data points are not tabulated; the paper states the limit is near eps~1e-5 for mX>~20 eV (slightly weaker than Park 2017's ~1e-5) and sensitivity is drastically reduced for mX<20 eV, with essentially no sensitivity below ~0.05 eV. The emitted two points are rough estimates from the text and should be treated as approximate; the actual excluded region spans roughly 20 eV to ~1 MeV.
